 Workbook data: on-hand, allocated, MOQ, lead time, open POs (promised dates). Calculated estimate: gross requirement = 3 months × estimated monthly usage (BOM × units sold × (1+scrap), demand held flat at its average; no forecast applied yet). Net = gross + safety stock (workbook policy) − available − scheduled receipts. Scheduled receipts = POs not received by the snapshot (verified); the comparison column shows net under the other source. Order-by = estimated stock-out date minus risk-adjusted lead time. Suggested quantities are rounded up to MOQ; confirm supplier terms before ordering.
